title: Purchase Manager – Solar Products
description:
Purchase Manager – Solar Products

**Location:** Angamaly, Kerala  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Industry:** Solar Energy / Renewable Energy  
**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹30,000 per month  
**Experience:** 3\+ years  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Purchase Manager** with relevant experience in **solar products and equipment procurement**. The candidate will be responsible for end\-to\-end purchasing, vendor management, price negotiation, purchase order management, and ensuring the timely availability of quality materials for solar projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end\-to\-end procurement of **solar products, equipment, components, and project materials**.
* Identify, evaluate, and develop reliable suppliers and vendors.
* Source materials and obtain competitive quotations from multiple vendors.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and other commercial terms.
* Prepare and manage purchase orders and procurement documentation.
* Ensure timely procurement and delivery of materials according to project requirements.
* Coordinate with **Project, Stores, Accounts, and Management teams** for smooth procurement operations.
* Verify product specifications, quality, quantity, pricing, and delivery terms before placing orders.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing suppliers and develop new vendor networks.
* Monitor pending purchase orders, delivery schedules, and material availability.
* Track market prices and maintain awareness of solar product availability and pricing trends.
* Resolve supplier\-related issues involving quality, delivery, pricing, and replacement of materials.
* Maintain accurate records of quotations, purchase orders, invoices, and vendor details.
* Ensure cost\-effective procurement while maintaining required quality standards.

Required Qualifications

* Degree/Diploma or relevant qualification in **Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering**, or a related field.
* Minimum **3 years of relevant experience in purchase/procurement**, preferably in the **Solar Energy or Renewable Energy industry**.
* Strong knowledge of **solar products, equipment, components, and procurement processes**.
* Excellent vendor management and negotiation skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in **MS Office, especially MS Excel**.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills.

Preferred Candidate

* Candidates with hands\-on experience in **solar product purchasing/procurement** will be preferred.
* **Immediate joiners** or candidates with a short notice period are preferred.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple procurement requirements.
* Strong focus on **cost control, timely delivery, and vendor relationship management**.

Compensation

**₹25,000 – ₹30,000 per month**, depending on the candidate's **experience, skills, and current CTC**.

Work Location

**Angamaly, Kerala**

title: Assistant Branch Manager
description:
Job Description**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:1\. Customer Service \& Branch Operations**

* Handle walk\-in customers, understand their requirements, and provide accurate product/service information.
* Enter walk\-in and lead details into company software and update the status daily.
* Address customer queries professionally and ensure high satisfaction levels.
* Ensure the safe movement and submission of gold and cash to Head Office/regional office or other branches as required.
* Maintain proper grooming standards, wear company uniform or formals with formal shoes.

**2\. Sales \& Lead Management**

* Identify and generate business opportunities through cold calls, follow\-ups, and marketing activities.
* Create and maintain a database of prospective customers, follow\-up until conversion, and support customers throughout the closing process.
* Execute marketing initiatives and distribute leaflets/pamphlets near by radius to increase brand visibility.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers to increase repeat business and referrals.

**3\. NBFC Coordination \& Business Development**

* Visit nearby NBFCs regularly to generate business leads.
* Build and maintain a healthy NBFC network and ensure consistent business inflow.

**4\. Sales Process Oversight \& Inventory Management**

* Oversee complete sales cycle from greeting to negotiation and final closing.
* Track daily sales performance and ensure targets are met.
* Maintain stock records, monitor stock ageing, and coordinate for replenishment.
* Ensure all operational equipment (POS, weighing machines, etc.) are functional.
* Prepare daily/weekly reports on sales, stock, and transactions.

**5\. Compliance \& SOP Adherence**

* Follow all safety, compliance, stock handling procedures and company SOPs without deviation.
* Conduct regular stock audits and ensure branch security protocols are followed.

**6\. Meetings, Reporting \& Inter\-Branch Support**

* Attend weekly, monthly, and quarterly review meetings without fail.
* Be flexible to support and work from other branches when required based on business needs.
* Ensure timely reporting, assigned tasks completion, and coordination with Regional Office /Head Office.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹28,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person
